summary: Full-stack test of Roomie (Expo web preview + FastAPI + Supabase). Backend pytest 7/7 passed (health, JWT auth guards 401/422, Kitchen AI suggest-meals structure + max_spend=0 honored). Frontend: login (John+Alex), home dashboard, floating nav + quick-add sheet, tasks (complete/add), inventory (count/search/use-item 200g→300g), grocery purchase flow (Milk ₹60 → purchased + expense + budget 1850→1790), expenses settle-up (math verified ₹215, Mark settled works), budget (+₹500 → ₹2,290, history), Kitchen AI (3 meal cards, expiry-aware reasons, No-Spend mode had no missing ingredients, Add-missing → 3 grocery items verified via REST, Cook This → inventory deducted exactly: Chicken 300→0, Tomatoes 4→2, Onions 5→4, Rice 2→1.8), profile + household (PALM26), dietary prefs, logout→welcome, Alex sees same shared data. FOUND+FIXED a critical realtime crash blocking all tab navigation. FOUND one critical Supabase schema bug (missing FK household_members→profiles) that cascades into member names/splits/notifications across the app.

critical.issue: PGRST200: no FK relationship between household_members and profiles in schema cache. AppContext loadUserData members fetch 400s → members=[] globally. Cascades: 'Unassigned' names everywhere (tasks avatars show 'U', settle-up 'Unassigned owes Unassigned', 'bought by there', history 'Unassigned added money'), empty assignee pills in new-task form, Budget Overview renders ZERO contribution rows (maps over empty members), Household screen shows '0 members' with empty list, notifyHousehold sends NO notifications (members empty → rows filtered out → John saw 'All quiet' after Alex-side actions), purchaseGrocery created 'Groceries — Milk' expense with EMPTY expense_splits (distorts settle-up: John net +60 uncountered). Fix: add FK constraint household_members.user_id → profiles.id in Supabase (then PostgREST reload), or fetch profiles in a second query and merge client-side.

minor.issue: Works correctly (200, structured meals, max_spend=0 honored). Minor: 503 on empty parse has no retry differentiation; acceptable.

ui_bugs.component: Tasks list / Expenses settle-up / Budget overview / Household members
ui_bugs.issue: All member-derived names render 'Unassigned' and avatars show 'U' due to the members=[] cascade from the missing profiles FK (see backend_issues.critical). Not a UI bug per se — will resolve once FK is fixed.

Grocery purchase INSERTs a new inventory_items row even when an item with the same name+unit exists — Milk now appears twice in inventory (count 7→8 with duplicate). Should merge/increment existing item quantity.

integration_issues.issue: Screen renders with empty state, but zero notifications were generated after task completion / grocery purchase / contribution because notifyHousehold receives members=[] (FK bug). Mark-all-read button only appears when entries exist — could not be exercised. Re-test after FK fix.
Works, but the 'Chicken finished → add to grocery' ConfirmSheet appears on top of results; verified visually. No issue, just noted.

issues: Design is consistent (off-white base, black pill nav, oversized numbers, 8pt spacing, 44px touch targets all verified in code and screenshots). Console warnings on web: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' — cosmetic RN-web deprecations worth cleaning up.

action_items: CRITICAL: Add FK constraint `household_members.user_id → profiles(id)` in Supabase (SQL: alter table household_members add constraint household_members_user_id_fkey foreign key (user_id) references profiles(id);) then reload PostgREST schema cache — this single fix restores member names, assignee pills, budget contribution rows, household member list, notifications fan-out, and purchase expense splits.

Verify my fix in src/lib/hooks.ts: realtime channel topics now have a unique per-instance suffix (realtime-js 2.117 reuses channels by topic; second subscriber's .on() after subscribe() threw and crashed every tab via ErrorBoundary). Keep the fix or implement a shared-subscription manager.
MEDIUM: Merge grocery-purchased items into existing inventory rows (match name+unit) instead of inserting duplicates.

LOW: Reconsider seed data dates — Supermarket/Electricity expenses are dated in the previous month so 'This month' totals show only new activity; either seed in current month or relabel demo expectations.
LOW: Clean up RN-web deprecation warnings (shadow* → boxShadow, props.pointerEvents).
Google sign-in provider not enabled in Supabase (known, out of scope).
critical_code_review_comments: src/lib/hooks.ts useHouseholdTable: supabase.channel(topic) MUST be unique per subscriber — realtime-js ≥2.11 returns the existing channel for a duplicate topic and .on() after subscribe() throws, crashing mounted tab stacks. Fixed with random suffix; consider a centralized subscription registry instead.

AppContext.tsx loadUserData silently swallows the members query error ({ data: membs } with no error check) — a failed join degrades to members=[] with no log/toast. Add error surfacing; silent-empty members corrupted splits and notifications downstream.

purchaseGrocery is not transactional: grocery update, inventory insert, expense insert, splits insert, wallet insert are sequential awaits — a mid-flow failure leaves partial state (e.g., expense without splits is exactly what happened). Consider a Postgres RPC for atomicity.
Backend server.py is clean: JWT verified against Supabase JWKS with audience/issuer checks, meals normalized defensively, 503 fallback on LLM failure. No issues.
Good: all interactive elements have testIDs; no HTML elements in RN code; no deprecated Expo packages (expo-av/barcode-scanner/background-fetch absent).

success_rate.frontend: ~90% — all requested flows pass except member-name-dependent rendering (blocked by missing FK) and notifications fan-out

The dominant blocker is the missing household_members→profiles FK: after E1 fixes it, retest (1) task avatars/assignee pills, (2) budget Overview contribution rows, (3) settle-up names, (4) notifications entries after cross-user actions + mark-all-read, (5) purchase flow creating expense_splits, (6) household screen member list. Demo budget is now ₹1,790 (not 1,850) due to tested Milk purchase; chicken is at 0g. Login helper: welcome screen has testID welcome-login → login-email/login-password/login-submit. Sheets animate in — wait ~1.2s before clicking buttons inside them.
rca_of_issue: BUG 1 (app crash on any tab navigation): @supabase/realtime-js 2.117.2 RealtimeClient.channel() returns the EXISTING channel for a duplicate topic. Expo Router keeps tab screens mounted, so Home's useTasks() channel stayed subscribed; mounting Tasks tab called .on() on the already-subscribed channel → 'cannot add postgres_changes callbacks after subscribe()' → ErrorBoundary 'Something went wrong'. Repro: login → tap Tasks tab. Fixed by appending a unique suffix per hook instance to channel topics in src/lib/hooks.ts; verified tabs + groceries + all screens no longer crash. BUG 2 (Unassigned everywhere): PostgREST PGRST200 — no FK between household_members and profiles, so select=*,profiles(*) returns 400, members=[] app-wide with cascading effects on names, splits, notifications. Needs DDL fix in Supabase by main agent.
